items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: You see, Monkey was playing drums with them, that's what they called him, Monkey, and he blowed in the kazoo.

ctx.x: Across from each other. Yeah, we had our own stand. You had your bandstand. Yeah, they had their own stand, yeah. They had their own stand, and they would dance floor in the middle?
You see, Monkey was playing drums with them, that's what they called him, Monkey, and he blowed in the kazoo. Kazoo. They didn't have no, uh, they didn't have no, uh, trumpet.
They had no trumpets? No, the Dixielands, they didn't have the old raguums.
